html:
The British South Africa Company (BSAC) was a company chartered by Britain in 1889 at the request of Cecil Rhodes. It conquered and ruled the lands that became Zimbabwe and Zambia, named Rhodesia after him.

Rhodes had grown rich from the Kimberley diamonds and hoped for a second gold field north of the Limpopo. His royal charter, like that of the Royal Niger Company, let the company make treaties, keep police and govern.

  • In 1890 its Pioneer Column marched into Mashonaland and founded Fort Salisbury, now Harare.
  • In 1893 it crushed the Ndebele kingdom of Lobengula with machine guns.
  • In 1896 and 1897 the Ndebele and Shona rose in revolt, the first Chimurenga, and were defeated.
  • Its men led the failed Jameson Raid into the Transvaal in 1895.

The hoped-for gold was modest, and the company handed over government in 1923 in Southern Rhodesia and 1924 in Northern Rhodesia. It kept the mineral rights of Northern Rhodesia's rich copper belt until Zambia became independent in 1964.
sum: The British South Africa Company (BSAC) was a company chartered by Britain in 1889 at the request of Cecil Rhodes. It conquered and ruled the lands that became Zimbabwe and Zambia, named Rhodesia after him.
